---
title: The student spinner!
page-layout: article
---

The grooviest way to choose the lucky contributor!!

```{ojs}
viewof spin_it = {
    return Inputs.button('Spin it!')
}
```
```{ojs}
viewof reset_it = Inputs.button('Reset')
```

```{ojs}
wheel = make_wheel(names) 
```
 
```{ojs}
names = ['Amina','Bryan M','Bryan PC','Carlos','Collin','David','Doug','Estelle','Fin','Gabriel','Isabel','Jacob C','Jacob S','James','Jordan','Leo','Lexi','Lilia','Miranda','Sal','William','Zachary']
```

```{ojs}
idx = {
  if(spin_it > 0) {
    const idx = Math.floor(names.length*Math.random());
    wheel.spinToIndex(idx, { extraRotations: 2, duration: 2000*(Math.random() + 1) });
    return idx;
  }
}
```
```{ojs}
reset = {
    if(reset_it > 0) {
        wheel.spinToIndex(0, {
            extraRotations: 0,
            duration: 500,
            ease: d3.easeSin
        })
    }
}
```

```{ojs}
import {make_wheel} from '/components/student_spinner.js'; 
```
